definition.value_dedup: three keys bound to one value: the value is one object, but every key still occupies an address, so this segment reports keys, distinct values and key reduction separately
definition.same_value_containment: a longer key is dropped only when a shorter key of the SAME value occurs contiguously inside it and no other record's whole key sits inside the longer key outside the kept span
definition.residual_guard: the guard refuses the drop when another key (any value) is entirely inside the longer key but outside the kept span; the unguarded simulation is reported to show what it prevented
definition.boundary_leak: a key that straddles the boundary of the dropped wording is not inside it, so the guard passes; the read then answers one extra value -- this is the measured blind spot
definition.cross_value: containment across different values is excluded by rule; compressing there would answer the short key's value for a query written as the long key's wording
definition.default_path: the 18-key table (9 corpus + 9 aliases) is compressed as well; nothing may be removed, the content digest must not move, and the R15 reading must stay 40/40
definition.zeros: 12 unknown candidates and 18 byte fragments must answer 0 on the default table
definition.closed_state: the nine closed-state readings stay equal before and after

criteria.value_dedup: three keys, one distinct value, three addresses, key reduction 0, and each key answers the same value
criteria.safe_containment: the nested pair goes 2 -> 1 record; before the drop the longer wording abstains at pass 1 (same-start tie), after the drop it answers the value at pass 2; the kept key still answers
criteria.residual_guard: the drop is blocked (3 -> 3 records, blocked key named); the reading still abstains; the unguarded simulation answers both values, which is what the guard prevented
criteria.boundary_leak: the drop happens (3 -> 2 records) and the read answers both values, including the value that the dropped wording was meant to cover -- the guard is table-local, not query-universal
criteria.cross_value: no record is removed, the cross-value pair is listed, and the hypothetical drop would answer the short key's value -- therefore the same-value condition is required
criteria.default_path: zero records removed, content digest unchanged, regression 40/40 with wrong 0, zeros 0/0
criteria.closed_state: the nine closed-state readings stay equal before and after
criteria.reporting: segments are reported separately; a safe nested pair does not carry the boundary segment, and the boundary segment is evidence against default compression, not for it
